## `summarise_by_group()`

Takes a data frame, the name of a grouping column and the name of a numeric
column. Returns one row per group with the mean and the number of
non-missing values. Missing values in the numeric column are ignored.

```{r}
summarise_by_group <- function(df, group, value) {
  groups <- unique(df[[group]])
  out <- data.frame()
  for (g in groups) {
    x <- df[df[[group]] == g, value]
    out <- rbind(out, data.frame(group = g, mean = mean(x), n = length(x)))
  }
  out
}

summarise_by_group(airquality, "Month", "Ozone")
```
